entries.title: Proportional Editing Falloff
entries.description: Controls the falloff curve used by proportional editing, so nearby geometry moves more than distant geometry.

entries.title: Snapping
entries.description: Turns on snapping, so moved objects or points lock to a target such as a grid point or another vertex.

entries.title: Point Light
entries.ui_path: 3D Viewport > Header > Add menu > Light > Point, then adjust in Properties > Object Data
entries.description: A light that shines evenly in every direction from a single point, similar to a bare light bulb.

entries.title: Extrude
entries.ui_path: Edit Mode > Header > Mesh menu > Extrude, or the E key
entries.description: Pulls new geometry out of a selected face, edge, or vertex, connecting it back to the rest of the mesh.

entries.title: Twisted Extrude
entries.ui_path: Edit Mode > Header > Mesh menu > Extrude, with rotation added while extruding
entries.description: A modeling technique that twists geometry as it extrudes. Often built with a small add-on or a driver on the extrude rotation.
